story.canonical_subject: Introducing AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel: Open Models for Speech and Decisions on Apple Platforms
facts: Hugging Face announced AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel for Apple platforms.
AnySpeechRecognizer mirrors Apple's SpeechAnalyzer API with engines like NVIDIA Parakeet and Alibaba Qwen3-ASR.
AnyDecisionModel handles typed decisions, multiple choice, and rating scale answers using local backends like MLX.

story.title: تحديث جديد لدليل السلوك النموذجي من أوبن إيه آي
facts: OpenAI updated its Model Spec with five core values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.
The update introduces guidance on context, oversight, and agency while retiring detailed style guidance.
Models are now referred to as GPT in the Spec instead of the assistant to reflect broader use cases.

story.title: إزاي المواقع تمنع الذكاء الاصطناعي بكلمة سر واحدة؟
facts: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal for AI training preferences.
The voluntary effort allows publishing preferences to multiple providers at once.
The change reduces the need to maintain separate rules for every crawler.
Existing crawler controls will continue to apply and be respected.
The initiative draws on the Internet Engineering Task Force work.
